horoscope: Mars just began its transit of your work and health sector, dear Aries, and this brings dynamic energy to your daily routines. You can be super-motivated to get more work done and to take better care of your body through more aggressive health and nutrition programs. Difficulties arise if you feel others are pushing their work on you or telling you what to do, and if you give in to impatience. Strive to assert yourself confidently and professionally. While this generally comes naturally to you, it may be a bit of a challenge now when you prefer to set your own pace. This transit lasts longer than the usual two months. In fact, it will stick with you until February 21st and then return from May 14th to July 15th. This is due to an upcoming retrograde cycle that may bring you back to old projects or decisions and prompt you to redo them. You may have a heavier workload, more errands and daily activities to attend to, or a greater need to incorporate exercise and activity into your daily routines. Today, the Moon heads into your home and family sector, however, and you seek more familiarity and security.

Mars has just moved into a sign that’s friendly with yours, dear Taurus, and this augurs well for your energy levels. It also helps you move through life at a good, healthy pace, encountering fewer obstacles than usual along the way. You might find asserting your needs or purpose is not only natural, but it also goes over well with others. You could get quite fired up romantically or sexually, or you could find a creative project especially exciting. Energy supports you in pursuing heartfelt activities. When Mars is challenged here, however, taking risks and possibly self-destructive ones should be watched for. Mars will stick around this area of your solar chart longer than its usual two months: now and until February 21st, and then later, from May 14th to July 15th. Today is strong for pleasant communications and opportunities to pursue your personal interests.

Mars has just begun its transit of your sector of home and family, dear Gemini, and will continue to influence this area of your solar chart until February 21st, returning again from May 14th to July 15th. This brings a lot of energy to your domestic life — possibly too much, at times! Used well, you can get a whole lot done around the home, and you can be more assertive and forthright with family members, perhaps clearing the air on some matters. However, expressing your desires, wants, and frustrations outside the domestic circle may not be as straightforward during this period. This can be a good time to entertain at home, although at times you may find your home life a little too busy. With Mars here, some sparks can fly if that’s what it takes to resolve problems. Today, the Moon heads into your resources cycle, encouraging you to settle in and enjoy yourself.

Mars has just begun its visit to your solar third house, dear Cancer, where it will transit until February 21st. Because of an upcoming retrograde cycle, this transit is longer than usual and comes in two parts. In fact, it will return again later from May 14th to July 15th. You can experience more motivation, initiative, courage, and energy in your communications, studies, mental pursuits, and daily life during this energizing cycle. You can be especially interested in doing things quickly and getting around more swiftly. You can be braver and more direct in your speech or writing, and you can more easily reach out and connect with others, although you may be absorbed in your projects during this period. On the challenging side, you may get into more conflicts with others, or you may be impatient such that getting around is a little more stressful. Otherwise, if you keep your energy in check, it’s a good time to get involved, learn, and actively pursue studies and personal interests. Today, the Moon moves into your sign for a stay of over two days, and your emotional needs move to the front burner.

Mars has just left your sign, dear Leo, and is now moving through your resources sector. While Mars in your sign in the past weeks has helped motivate you, this new cycle takes some of the pressure off. Note that in January, Mars will turn retrograde and, on February 21st, will return to your sign. It will have more work to do! For now, your focus shifts from personality to security, including business and financial concerns. This cycle can push you to take better care of your valuables and finances, but it’s also a strong period for building confidence in your own worth or value. You can handle self-esteem issues with more self-honesty. If you feel that you’ve been undervaluing yourself or your talents, then this is the time to make things right. Difficulties can arise during this period if you feel others aren't respecting you or your things, or if you are too impulsive with spending. Focus now on building rather than squandering your resources. Feel the increased courage to earn what you deserve!

Fiery and go-getting Mars just entered your sign, dear Virgo, and will spend more time than usual in Virgo — until February 21st and then from May 14th-July 15th. This transit draws out the enthusiasm and dynamism in your personality. The period ahead is one of innovation, new beginnings, and increased courage. If you need to take on demanding or challenging projects, this can be an excellent time to do so. However, patience may not be your strong suit, so this doesn’t include complicated or intricate tasks. Use this period for shaping your life how you want it to be. Tap into your natural bravery, but avoid rash decisions and behavior. This is a great time to tackle projects you’ve let slide and direct your considerable energy into reviving works in progress or new endeavors. You are in a good position to pursue your goals with passion and heart. Today, with the Moon moving into your solar sector, you’re especially sociable and find it easy to get along with others.

Your need for solitude and time to yourself increases now as Mars has just begun its transit of your solar twelfth house, dear Libra. This transit will continue until February 21st, then return from May 14th to July 15th. It points to a need for rest and recuperation — a time-out for sorting things out. Of course, life goes on as usual, but you may need more time to yourself. Your energy levels can be at a low or they can fluctuate during this cycle. In general, this is a time to recharge your energy reserves or handle lingering matters from the past that still affect you in the present. It’s a period for research and reflection, incubating new plans rather than going full-speed ahead with new ventures, and putting an end to endeavors or goals that no longer serve you well. Sometimes, this points to a time when past actions catch up with you, or when you’re doing a lot behind the scenes, out of the public eye, or on your own. Take this time to reassess where you’re headed. Do your best to honor your needs for extra rest, meditation, privacy, and reflection. Today, however, the Moon moves to the top of your solar chart, and you're ready to step up to the plate. It's a good time to set goals.

You've just entered a cycle, lasting until February 21st, dear Scorpio, in which you have natural energy and drive for organizing projects, making plans, taking the lead in group endeavors, and pursuing and enjoying friendships. This transit makes it easier to move forward and chase your desires without running into too many obstacles. Mars is now working in harmony with your sign, which is helpful. You may be working with others towards a common goal, or you could be putting more energy into networking or activities with friends, causes, or group activities. This is also a period when you enjoy taking charge and organizing events. Others may be more demanding of you during this cycle, but for the most part, it’s a pleasant sort of popularity you’re experiencing now. If there have been problems brewing with a friend or group, however, this transit can bring things out into the open. If this is the case, though, it’s useful to clear things up. Note that in January, Mars will turn retrograde in this same sector, and you’ll be doing some reassessing of projects you’re taking on now. Some will be revisiting old friendships.

Mars has just begun its transit of your solar tenth house, dear Sagittarius, and will stick around here for a more extended stretch than usual – until February 21st and then again from May 14th to July 15th – compared to its average of two months. Ambitions are stirring, and you are especially eager to perform well, meet your responsibilities, and take charge. You’ve likely had many ideas about what you’d like to do to improve your life, and now you feel you have the tools and confidence to act on them. There may be times during this cycle that you feel you are in the hot seat, however, as you don’t always agree with others about how to do things and prefer to make your own decisions. While it’s important to assert your needs, try not to overplay your hand, or else you may be inviting unnecessary conflict. With Mars in conflict with your sign during this cycle, things aren’t handed to you. In fact, you work for them and overcome obstacles and challenges, but you’re also quite motivated to do so. Today is strong for gluing the pieces together and feeling the satisfaction of having done so.

Mars has just begun its transit of your spirit sector, dear Capricorn, and is now moving in harmony with your sign. You are braver and more courageous, ready to take action, and especially eager during this cycle that lasts until February 21st and then continues later from May 14th to July 15th. This transit acts to release inhibitions, and it’s helpful for competitions, whether these are related to games and sports or business! You can find it quite natural to assert your desires and pursue your goals directly and spontaneously. You’re more spirited and willing to seek activities that require a little extra courage. You tend to move through the world at the right speed, neither too aggressively nor too meekly. Your sense of adventure is strong, and there can be some friends made or improvements to existing friendships as a result of your willingness to move outside of your regular routines. Mind you, this transit is longer than usual due to an upcoming retrograde Mars cycle, and some slowdowns are likely to occur. However, it's a powerful period for really getting in touch with your desires.

Mars has just begun its transit of your intimacy and sharing sector, dear Aquarius, and will continue this transit until February 21st. This can be a time of intensity within yourself or in a close relationship. A lot is happening behind the scenes as Mars stirs up hidden or deeper desires. You tend to write your own rules during this transit, and you are more aware of your own instincts and impulses. Sometimes this transit correlates with disputes over money, and complications are possible from January 10th onward when Mars turns retrograde in this sector of your solar chart. You may need to take the lead or to take action in connection with shared finances, loans, or debts. However, it’s important not to rush a financial or intimate matter, even if it's tempting to do so. If you need the courage to handle issues along these lines, you'll certainly have it in the coming weeks. Today, while you're inclined to want to keep busy to some degree, you'd be wise to make extra time for activities that boost the body and mind now as well.

Mars has just begun its energizing transit of your solar seventh house, dear Pisces, and will stick around this area of your chart for far longer than usual — until February 21st and then from May 14th to July 15th rather than its usual two months or so. During this cycle, relationships with others are unlikely to be boring! You or a partner can be more assertive in your relationship. There’s bound to be a lot of friction, which need not be difficult if handled well. There can be some real back-and-forth or push-and-pull as you attempt to work towards equality and balance in a personal relationship. Your relationships tend to move quickly now, and there can be conflicts but also resolutions. Problems that have been ignored or left to fester have a way of surfacing during this cycle. A partner tends to challenge you right now, and you may see this as helpful or disruptive, or a bit of both! There can be a lot of energy and activity in a relationship as it moves quickly, is lively, or filled with conflict. Today, the Moon moves into your sector of joy, and relationships feel more straightforward, and you get a sense that things are moving along well.
